prompt: Create an interactive HTML presentation explaining Gradient Descent optimization. It should have a visual canvas showing a 2D loss surface (quadratic curve) and an interactive slider to alter the learning rate (step size), drawing the gradient steps dynamically to show convergence vs divergence.

assertions.name: has_slide_deck_structure
assertions.description: Output contains elements with the class 'slide'.

assertions.name: has_canvas_and_slider
assertions.description: Output contains a canvas and a range input slider.

assertions.name: implements_keyboard_navigation
assertions.description: JavaScript implements keydown navigation for Arrow keys or Space.
